@@U02300@@
and if he likes, he can use them, for ancient wines stand nearby. But— and you can take my word for it— the wooden staves rotted long ago, and tartar forms the cask that holds the wine. Not only gold and jewels seek out the night, but also the essences of such wines. The wise man works here undismayed. To search for treasure in daylight is child’s play; mysteries are at home in darkness.

@@U02302@@
I leave the mysteries to you! What good is gloom? Things worth having must be seen. And who can tell a thief in the dark? At night all cats are gray and cows black, and as for those gold-heaped pots of yours, plow them up and let us see them.

@@U02304@@
Take hoe and spade and dig for yourself. The work of a peasant will make you strong, and a herd of golden calves will rise from the earth. With no hesitation then, and with full delight, you can adorn yourself and your beloved, for jewels, colorful and sparkling, will be yours to enhance both majesty and beauty.

@@U02306@@
Yes! Just hurry! How long must we wait?

@@U02308@@
(Prompted again by 梅菲斯特.)

@@U02309@@
Sire, you must moderate your too great eagerness.
translation:
@@U02300@@
如果他愿意，他可以使用它们，因为附近就有古老的葡萄酒。但是——你可以相信我的话——木棍很久以前就已经腐烂了，而装酒的木桶里就形成了牙垢。不仅黄金和珠宝在寻找夜晚，而且这些葡萄酒的精髓也在寻找。智者在这里毫不沮丧地工作。白天寻找宝藏是小孩子的游戏；神秘就在黑暗中。

@@U02302@@
我把谜团留给你！忧郁有什么好处？值得拥有的东西一定要被看见。谁能在黑暗中辨别小偷呢？到了晚上，猫都是灰色的，牛都是黑色的，至于你那堆金盆栽，把它们犁出来让我们看看。

@@U02304@@
拿起锄头和铁锹，自己挖。农民的劳动将使你变得坚强，一群金牛犊将从大地中崛起。那么，您就可以毫不犹豫地、满心欢喜地装饰自己和心爱的人，因为色彩缤纷、闪闪发光的珠宝将属于您，增添威严和美丽。

@@U02306@@
是的！快点吧！我们还要等多久？

@@U02308@@
（梅菲斯特再次提示。）

@@U02309@@
陛下，您必须节制一下您过于急切的情绪。
